evidence.ACL: Enlarged size and signal of ACL, in favor of mucoid degeneration.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing articular cartilage and subchondral edema , more prominent at medial femorotibial joint and spur.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing articular cartilage and subchondral edema , more prominent at medial femorotibial joint and spur.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst
evidence.Contusion: Wearing articular cartilage and subchondral edema , more prominent at medial femorotibial joint and spur.
